newsitem.title: USA: Scudder declines comment on report it seeks buyer.
newsitem.headline: Scudder declines comment on report it seeks buyer.

text.p: Money management firm Scudder, Stevens & Clark Inc declined to comment on a report that it was looking for buyers among U.S. and foreign financial institutions.
A spokeswoman said it was Scudder's policy not to comment on rumors and speculation.
The Wall Street Journal reported on Thursday that the firm has been approached by as many as six firms.
The newspaper reported that people close to the matter said companies in talks included Union Bank of Switzerland (UBS) and Chase Manhattan Corp.
Fund Action, a weekly newsletter, had reported talks between UBS and Scudder on Monday.
